verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official, documented MCP server (mcp.ramp.com) with OAuth-gated scopes, admin access controls, and a supplementary Developer MCP and Data MCP, corroborated by a live probe showing a working OAuth-protected JSON-RPC endpoint with a rich scope list. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Ramp) hands-on report of using the MCP server in production, and full parity confirmation (e.g., bill approvals are explicitly noted as not yet available via MCP).
